synopsis: The toys are back in Disney and Pixar's "Toy Story 5," and this time it's Toy meets Tech. Woody (Tom Hanks), Buzz Lightyear (Allen), Jessie (Joan Cusack) and the rest of the gang's jobs are in jeopardy when they come face-to-face with Lilypad (Greta Lee), a brand-new tablet device that arrives with her own disruptive ideas about what is best for their kid, Bonnie. Will playtime ever be the same?
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis: Set in rural Maharashtra, Cactus Pears follows Anand (Bhushaan Manoj), a Mumbai call-centre worker who returns to his ancestral village to observe the ten-day mourning ritual following his father’s death. While navigating the pressures of family expectations and marriage, he reconnects with Balya (Suraaj Suman), a childhood friend facing similar struggles. Over the course of the mourning period, their bond deepens into a tender and intimate relationship, creating a quiet exploration of grief, id

The Invite is a marital dark comedy directed by Olivia Wilde (Booksmart/Don’t Worry Darling), adapted from the 2020 Spanish film The People Upstairs. It follows Joe and Angela, an unhappy, bickering San Francisco couple who host their enigmatic, sexually uninhibited upstairs neighbors for a chaotic dinner party that quickly spirals into raw, hilarious emotional warfare. Warning: This film contains sequences with flashing or flickering lights that may affect individuals with photosensitivity. Vie

movie_title: Pitchblack Playback: Marvin Gaye 'What's Going On (55th Anniversary)
movie_title_en: Pitchblack Playback: Marvin Gaye 'What's Going On (55th Anniversary)
synopsis: Immerse yourself in one of the greatest albums of all-time at Pitchblack Playback's listening session in the dark, celebrating its 55th anniversary. Hear this stunning album played loud in uncompressed audio on our powerful cinema sound system. No phones; no talking; no signing; no distractions; just you and the music. And introducing Pitchblack Pairings: our way of introducing you to records you might not know that fit perfectly with the main event. After 'What's Going On' and a 10-minute inter
tmdb_overview: When Marvin Gaye died in 1984, he left behind one of the great legacies in American music. More than a superb vocalist and subtle composer, he was a visionary who expressed the tenor of his times. Both radical and romantic, a self-taught singer with a flair for autobiographical revelation, he thrived on confession and loved candor.

tmdb_overview: A playful and personal journey through Lebanon’s audiovisual memory, composed entirely of archival footage. It is a love letter to Beirut, spanning 70 years of film, TV, home videos, and photography, exploring the Lebanese collective psyche – marked by joy and intimacy, destruction and loss. synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from within
tmdb_overview: Caudillo is a documentary film by Spanish film director Basilio Martín Patino. It follows the military and political career of Francisco Franco and the most important moments of the Spanish Civil War. It uses footage from both sides of the war, music from the period and voice-over testimonies of various people.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Spain in the 1930s is the place to be for a man of action like Robert Jordan. There is a civil war going on and Jordan—who has joined up on the side that appeals most to idealists of that era—has been given a high-risk assignment up in the mountains. He awaits the right time to blow up a crucial bridge in order to halt the enemy's progress.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Edee, in the aftermath of an unfathomable event, finds herself unable to stay connected to the world she once knew and in the face of that uncertainty, retreats to the magnificent, but unforgiving, wilds of the Rockies. After a local hunter brings her back from the brink of death, she must find a way to live again.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from outside
tmdb_overview: Joris Ivens’s advocacy documentary for the Republican cause intercuts a besieged Madrid with a nearby village digging an irrigation canal, linking the war to bread, land, and survival. Produced by the writers’ collective Contemporary Historians, edited by Helen van Dongen, scored by Marc Blitzstein, and narrated in its U.S. version by Ernest Hemingway (after an initial Orson Welles track), it blends frontline reportage with persuasion against Franco’s forces and their German–Italian backers.

synopsis: The Spanish Civil War seen from within
tmdb_overview: The creative and ambitious Carlos, a young Spanish film buff, manages to become a professional camera operator with time and effort, and is also blessed with the love of Ana, which he has longed for; but the outbreak of the Civil War in 1936 changes everything for both of them.

Kira is living her life with the teenage confidence that the world revolves around her. Born and raised in the late Soviet Ukraine, she sees her life predictable and clear. But it doesn't last long. Suddenly, she discovers that her father has a mistress, and her mother knows about it but prefers to remain silent. As Kira's family begins to fall apart —and so does the Soviet State— everything she knew turns out to be an illusion. Kira is searching for love, warmth, and hope for the future, going down a dark path she could not foresee.

tmdb_overview: Derry, 1972; As the civil rights movement across the North of Ireland begins to secure unprecedented wins, the British state responds with lethal force, murdering 14 people and sparking a 60 year fight for justice and accountability by a community for whom everything had changed. From the acclaimed directors of ‘To Kill a War Machine’ and the community who took on the British state and won, ‘The Day Innocence Died’ tells the story of the Bloody Sunday massacre and its legacy, weaving unheard testimonies and indelible archive footage into an epic  cinematic documentary.

movie_title: Elon Musk Unveiled – The Tesla Experiment
movie_title_en: Elon Musk Unveiled – The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_title: Elon Musk Unveiled: The Tesla Experiment
tmdb_overview: It's 2014 and tech billionaire Elon Musk unveils his plans for a self-driving car in front of an enthusiastic audience. What consumers don't know is that Tesla's "autopilot" function is far from road-ready, and new owners are being used to improve the software by providing their data. A fatal accident in Florida triggers a protracted lawsuit to hold Tesla accountable. And it's not the only incident. Shocking footage from dashcams and security cameras shows the ruthlessness of Tesla cars suddenly braking or accelerating—and the crashes that follow. Then, an employee leaks thousands of documents containing complaints from users.

Originally released as "The $19.98 Home Vid: Cliff 'Em All," Metallica's first video is a tribute to late original bassist Cliff Burton. James Hetfield describes it as "a compilation of bootleg footage shot by sneaky Metallifux, stuff shot for TV that was never used, but we've held onto, home footage, personal fotos and us drunk. But most important, it's really a look back at the 3-1/2 years that Cliff was with us and includes his best bass solos and the home footage and pix that we feel best capture his unique personality and style." 1987.

Cunning Stunts is a concert video by heavy metal band Metallica, recorded live in Fort Worth, Texas, on 9-10 May 1997. It was released in DVD and VHS formats. The DVD features concert footage, band interviews, a documentary, behind the scenes footage and a photo gallery consisting of approximately 1,000 photos. Three of the performances feature multiple angles. During the performance of the song 'Enter Sandman', the entire stage is set to appear to collapse and explode, with pyrotechnics and a technician (referred to in the extras as the 'Burning Dude') who runs across the stage while on fire, as another technician swings overhead. This is also one of the only Metallica concerts that didn't feature 'Ecstasy of Gold' as an intro.

A lighthearted take on director Yasujiro Ozu’s perennial theme of the challenges of inter­generational relationships, Good Morning tells the story of two young boys who stop speaking in protest after their parents refuse to buy a television set. Ozu weaves a wealth of subtle gags through a family portrait as rich as those of his dramatic films, mocking the foibles of the adult world through the eyes of his child protagonists. Shot in stunning color and set in a suburb of Tokyo where housewives gossip about the neighbors’ new washing machine and unemployed husbands look for work as door-to-door salesmen, this charming comedy refashions Ozu’s own silent classic I Was Born, But . . . to gently satirize consumerism in postwar Japan.

Unemployed, and with no family, he hopes to find a place to commit seppuku—and a worthy second to deliver the coup de grâce in his suicide ritual. The senior counselor for the Iyi clan questions the ronin’s resolve and integrity, suspecting Hanshirō of seeking charity rather than an honorable end. tmdb_overview: Derry, 1972; As the civil rights movement across the North of Ireland begins to secure unprecedented wins, the British state responds with lethal force, murdering 14 people and sparking a 60 year fight for justice and accountability by a community for whom everything had changed. From the acclaimed directors of ‘To Kill a War Machine’ and the community who took on the British state and won, ‘The Day Innocence Died’ tells the story of the Bloody Sunday massacre and its legacy, weaving unheard testimonies and indelible archive footage into an epic  cinematic documentary.

movie_title: Above And Below The Line Exhibition Launch Event: Italian Women In The Film Industry, Past & Present
movie_title_en: Above And Below The Line Exhibition Launch Event: Italian Women In The Film Industry, Past & Present
synopsis:
To mark the opening of “Above and Below The Line”, a launch event will take place on 3 July at 19:30 at Regent Street Cinema. Developed as part of a collaborative research project between the University of Warwick, Oxford Brookes University and Cineteca di Bologna, it builds on the original exhibition presented in Bologna last summer.

Highlighting roles such as assistant directors, screenwriters, script supervisors and stills photographers, the exhibition brings visibility to women whose contributions were often overlooked in a historically male-dominated industry.

The evening will include:
● Introduction to the exhibition by representatives of the partner institutions.
● A screening of compilations of extracts from interviews with women who recount their experiences of working in the Italian film industry.
● A panel discussion with contemporary Italian female filmmakers working in different roles: Roberta Bonomi (editor), Giulia Gandini (TV Director), Ilaria Fulvio (Assistant Camera), Eleonora Pesci (Acquisition Manager at Curzon), Eleonora Cao Pinna (Assistant Director), moderated by Alessandra Gonnella (Filmmaker and Founder of Nervosa Pictures).

The event is aimed at press, institutions, filmmakers and film enthusiasts, with the goal of raising awareness and reaching new generations around the valuable and often underrepresented work of women filmmakers.

A complimentary glass of Zonin Prosecco will be offered to every ticket holder.

Courtesy of Nervosa Pictures, University of Warwick, Istituto Italiano di Cultura, Cineteca di Bologna, Humanities and Arts Research Council, Zonin Prosecco.

synopsis:
All of Us Strangers  & Q&A with Author, John Grindod
Genre(s): Drama/Fantasy/RomanceUK/USA| 2023 | 105 minsDirector: Andrew Haigh
Stars: Andrew Scott, Paul Mescal, Jamie Bell, Claire Foy

A special screening of Andrew
Haigh's All of Us Strangers, a film beloved of queer
Croydonians, not least because it was set and shot in the borough. The
screening will be followed by a Q&A with Croydon-born writer John Grindrod
discussing the film and the many themes it shares with his new book, Tales
of the Suburbs: LGBTQ+ Lives Behind Net Curtains. Discover stories
of isolation and escape, love and community; and prepare to be devastated all
over again by one of the great modern movies, back in its spiritual home. 
Followed by Q
& A with author John Grindrod, in partnership with Croydon Pride.
tmdb_overview: One night in his near-empty tower block in contemporary London, Adam has a chance encounter with a mysterious neighbor, which punctures the rhythm of his everyday life.

ARCO
Genre(s): AnimationUSA | 2026 | 88 minsDirector: Ugo BienvenuFamily Film Club screening in association with Croydon Family Hubs: Tickets £6

it takes to help him return home. This Oscar and BAFTA nominated hand-drawn

synopsis:
Come See Me In the Good Light 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUSA | 2025 ! 104 minsDirector: Ryan
WhiteCast: Megan Falley, Andrea Gibson
Introduction and Q&A with Jo Scanlan. 
Tickets are free but please consider making a donation to the cinema when booking.

This Oscar-nominated
documentary tells the story of poets and lovers Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley,
and how they deal with the former’s diagnosis of ovarian cancer. Through the
highs and lows of the ongoing treatment, the partners attempt to live a full
and happy life, which the film reflects through their poetry, prose, raunchy

traumas.

synopsis:
Effi O Blaenau 
Genre(s): DramaUK| 2026| 91 mins (Welsh with English Subtitles).Director: Marc EvansStars: Leisa Gwenllian, Tom Rhys Harries, Owen AlunBased on the acclaimed
one-woman play Iphigenia in Splott, this Welsh-language film version moves the action to the
North Wales town of Blaenau, a dreary place
surrounded by grey slate tips, where Effi tries desperately to enjoy life on
the dole through a haze of clubbing and alcohol. An encounter with a disabled
soldier seems to promise her some hope, but things soon descend into chaos… But
Effi fights back. Leisa Gwenllian gives a tour-de-force
performance as Effi, and aided by Evans’s direction, she has you rooting for
her character as fate and the elements conspire against her. An affecting and
moving drama in the British social realist tradition.
tmdb_overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

Fame 
Genre(s): Drama/MusicalUSA| 1980 | 134 MinsDirector: Alan ParkerStars: Eddie Barth, Lee Curreri, Irene Cara.Set in New York’s High School of Performing Arts, Fame follows a disparate group of students from different backgrounds as they audition and then study at the school. We see how they progress across four years of study, as they aim to make it big in their chosen areas of the entertainment world. Various audition and performance scenes, along with the characters’ personal experiences are expertly woven into Christopher Gore’s screenplay, and the result is a joyful celebration of youth, hope and talent.

Familiar Touch 
Genre(s): DramaUSA | 2024 | 92 minsDirector: Sarah FriedlandCast: Kathleen Chalfant, Carolyn Michelle, Andy McQueenOur 2:30pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.
Familiar Touch is
a tender and deeply human portrait of Ruth, an older woman navigating the
disorienting transition into assisted living. As memory begins to blur, she
grapples with identity, independence, and her evolving relationships with those
around her. Director Sarah Friedland invites us to experience the world through
Ruth’s perspective, balancing moments of memory loss
with flashes of humour and connection. Anchored by Kathleen Chalfant’s quietly
powerful performance, this compassionate directorial debut from Friedland finds
dignity within the fragility of change. 
Inspired by writer/director Sarah Friedland‘s work as a memory care worker and teaching artist to older adults, FAMILIAR TOUCH is an intergenerational production made in collaboration with the residents and care workers at a Los Angeles retirement community. 
This film will be preceded by a 4 min short - CALL OF THE CRANES 
The filmakers say "CALL OF THE CRANES was created by and with the older people performing in the film. They’re members of 'The Memory Gang' in Hämeenlinna, southern Finland, a self-organised group of people living with or close to memory loss. The Memory Gang is always on the lookout for inspiring and exciting activities to do together. The creative spark for CALL OF THE CRANES came from The Memory Gang members after they'd watched a short film, CRANE, and wondered how the story might continue. That's where this film work began!
tmdb_overview: An octogenarian woman transitions to life in assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship to herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.

Flirting 
Genre(s): Romance/DramaAustralia/UK | 1991 | 95 minsDirector: John DuiganCast: Noah Taylor, Nicole Kidman, Thandie Newton
A 35mm presentation in association with The Cinema Museum. 
The second
autobiographical film by Duigan after The Year My Voice Broke. Taylor
again plays Danny, now at a rural boarding school, where he meets Thandiwe, the
rebellious daughter of African parents, who studies at the nearby Girl’s
college. Before long a romance develops between the two, who must get around
the rules of both institutions to see each other. This tender and perceptive
film sees early performances from female stars Kidman and Newton, as well as
Naomi Watts.
tmdb_overview: Two freethinking teenagers - a boy and a girl - confront with authoritarian teachers in their boarding schools. The other students treat this differently.

synopsis:

follows the ghost of banker Sam Wheat as he tries to ensure the safety
of his girlfriend Molly from the man who arranged his murder — with
the help of charlatan psychic Oda Mae Brown (played by the Oscar-winning Whoopi
Goldberg). A poignant romance, mixed with elements of comedy, horror, and
mystery, Ghost was a popular hit both in cinemas and on VHS.

Ish 
Genre: DramaUK | 2025 | 89 minsDirector: Imran PerrettaStars: Farhan Hasnat, Yahya Kitana, Sudha BhucharSet in Luton, this coming-of-age drama
follows 12-year-old best friends Ish and Maram (non-professional actors Farhan
Hasnat and Yahya Kitana, themselves friends since childhood) as they try to
make the most of their summer. After a traumatic police stop-and-search
incident, cracks begin to appear in their friendship, forcing the boys to
confront the realities of growing up in a world that views them with
suspicion.As their lives gradually
diverge, each must make sense of the men they are becoming and learn that
letting go can be one of the hardest parts of growing up. A contemporary
portrait of British childhood exploring masculinity, friendship and racial
profiling and facial recognition technology with compassion and insight.

synopsis:
Michael 
Genres: Biography | Drama | Music2025 | USA | 127 mins Director: Antoine FuquaCast: Jaafar Jackson, Juliano Valdi, Colman Domingo, Jayden HarvilleTracing the early life and meteoric
rise of one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, Michael charts
the journey of Michael Jackson from his beginnings as the precociously talented
lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his emergence as a global superstar during the
era of his landmark Bad tour. Portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson,
the film explores the ambition, creativity and pressures that shaped his
ascent. Blending intimate moments with recreations of iconic performances, it
offers a portrait of the artist behind the phenomenon — capturing both the
brilliance and the drive that defined his early career.
tmdb_overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:
Minions & Monsters 
Genre(s): AnimationUSA/UK | 2026 | 120 minsDirector: Pierre CoffinStars: Zoey Deutch, Allison Janney, Bobby Moynihan, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff BridgesScreened in collaboration with Croydon Family Hubs, all tickets are £6In 1920s Hollywood, Minions are enjoying wild success as
silent movie stars - until the ‘talkies’ arrive. James and Henry decide to make
their own movie and summon fearsome monsters from a mysterious spellbook to
play the villains. Lovecraftian creature Goomi leads them on a quest to find
the ultimate monster, but when things go haywire, all Minions must band
together to save the world. Look out for silent film star cameos and an
all-star voice cast in this hugely enjoyable prequel to Minions (2015) and Minions:
The Rise of Gru (2022).
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
Nino 
Genre(s): DramaFrance | 2025 | 97 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Pauline LoquèsStars: Théodore Pellerin, William Lebghil, Salomé
Dewaels
NINO contains a sequence of flashing lights, 
which might affect viewers with photosensitive epilepsy.
One Friday in Paris, his 29th birthday, Nino
receives an unexpected cancer diagnosis. With chemotherapy due to start on
Monday, he is given the delicate task of producing a sperm sample in case the
treatment leaves him infertile. This incredibly moving and often funny French
drama sees Nino spend the weekend adrift in Paris, attempting to
reconnect with others and stumbling over the words to share his shocking news.
Théodore Pellerin's tender performance won prizes at both Cannes and the Césars
in this promising debut feature.
tmdb_overview: Nino is a young man on a journey to reconnect with the world and himself in the streets of Paris, following the suggestion of his doctors. In three days, he will face a major challenge.

synopsis:
NT Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses 
Genre: Theatrical PerformanceUK | 2026 | 180 minsDirector: Marianne ElliottStars: Lesley Manville, Aidan Turner, Monica Barbaro
BAFTA Award-winner Lesley Manville (Phantom Thread) joins
Aidan Turner (Rivals) in a striking new staging of Christopher Hampton’s
celebrated adaptation of the classic novel, where among the glittering salons
of the super-rich, one misstep can mean ruin.  Marquise de Merteuil is a
master in the art of survival. Alongside the magnetic Vicomte de Valmont, they
turn seduction into strategy and weaponise desire. But when their alliance
collapses into rivalry, the battle between them threatens to destroy everyone
in their path. Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Marianne Elliott (Angels
in America) directs this thrilling game of love, lies, and social warfare.
There will be a 15 minute interval at the end of act 1. Our Arts Bar will reopen to allow customers to purchase drinks and snacks to take into the cinema.

synopsis:
NT Live: The Playboy of the Western World 
Genre: Theatre PerformanceUK | 2026 | 157 minsDirector: Caitríona McLaughlinStars: Nicola Coughlan, Siobhán McSweeney, Éanna Hardwicke
Nicola Coughlan (Bridgerton) joins Éanna Hardwicke (The Sixth Commandment) and Siobhán McSweeney (Derry Girls) in John Millington Synge’s riveting play of youth and self-discovery. Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene. Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Caitríona McLaughlin directs this darkly funny tale full to the brim with secrets.
Run time includes a 20 minute interval. Our Arts Bar will reopen to serve drinks and snacks.

Savage House 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaUK | 2025 | 114 minsDirector: Peter GlanzStars: Richard E Grant, Claire Foy, Jack Farthing, Bel PowleyOur 2:30pm screening includes Descriptive subtitles for those with hearing difficulties.England,
1740. Lady Vane and Lord Ashwick will do anything to claw their way to the top
of society - lie, scheme, blackmail, and butcher their way through polite
company if they must. Claire Foy and Richard E. Grant star in this deliciously
vicious period romp, where corsets are tight, morals are loose, and the body
count keeps rising. Sharp-tongued, blood-splattered, and wickedly funny, Savage
House skewers the brutal absurdity of class obsession with gleeful,
unapologetic savagery.
tmdb_overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

synopsis:
Stand By Me 
Genre(s): Adventure| Comedy | DramaUSA 1986 | 88 minsDirector: Rob ReinerStars: Wil Wheaton, River Phoenix, Corey Feldman, Jerry O'Connell, Kiefer Sutherland.Our 2pm screening will be followed by a post-film discussion hosted by the U3A film club. Everyone is welcome to stay and join in.The late Rob Reiner directed this version of
Stephen King’s novella The Body to great critical and popular acclaim. A writer
(played by Richard Dreyfuss) looks back to the time when he and three friends
set out on a journey to find the body of a missing boy. The friends hope
finding the body will make them heroes, but instead their friendship is
strengthened. The film pays tribute to the icons and beliefs of the fifties,
but still remains well-observed without falling to over-used nostalgia. “A masterclass
in directing, storytelling and acting” (The Guardian).
tmdb_overview: After learning that a boy their age has been accidentally killed near their rural homes, four boys decide to go see the body. Gordie, Vern, Chris, and Teddy encounter a mean junk man and a marsh full of leeches, but they also learn more about one another and their very different home lives. Just a lark at first, the boys' adventure evolves into a defining event in their lives.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 
Genres: Comedy/DramaUSA | 2025 | 119 minsDirector: David FrankelCast: Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci
Our Thursday 2pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-film discussion in association with the U3A film group. Anyone can stay and join in.
Twenty years on, The Devil Wears Prada 2
struts back onto the scene with its original cast and a fresh dose of
high-fashion drama. Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) — ice-cold stare intact —
is fighting to keep her fashion magazine Runway relevant as the print media
world crumbles. Her former protégé Anne Hathaway returns in considerably better
shoes, but it's former assistant-turned-rival Emily Blunt who may prove
Miranda's most formidable foe yet. Stilettos are sharpened, alliances tested,
and the drama is more fabulous than ever.
tmdb_overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

Her former protégé Anne Hathaway returns in considerably better shoes, but it's former assistant-turned-rival Emily Blunt who may prove Miranda's most formidable foe yet. Stilettos are sharpened, alliances tested, and the drama is more fabulous than ever.

The Last Viking 
Genre(s): Comedy/Crime/DramaDenmark/Sweden | 2025 | 116 mins (Danish with English Subtitles)Director: Anders Thomas JensenStars: Mads Mikkelsen, Sofie Gråbøl, Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Lars Ranthe, John LennonBank robber Anker entrusts the loot from
his latest robbery with his brother Manfred just before he is captured. On his
release from prison, he seeks out his brother, but Manfred now believes himself
to be John Lennon – and he cannot remember where the money is buried. Empathy
between the brothers is not helped by Ankers’s short temper. They return to
their childhood holiday home, where the loot may be hidden, to work things out,
joined by a group of other characters (played by Sofie Gråbøl and other
well-known faces from TV Scandi noir). A well-acted black comedy, full of
hilarious misadventures and fun slapstick sequences.

synopsis:
The Sheep Detectives 
Genre(s) Comedy/Action/Mystery/FamilyUK/USA/Ireland | 2026 | 109 minsDirector: Kyle BaldaCast: Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, Emma Thompson
Our 2pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-film discussion in association with the Croydon u3a Film Group.
George
Hardy is a shepherd living in a quiet English rural community, keeping himself
to himself, and reading crime books to his flock every evening. Little does he
know that they understand every word, and when he is discovered dead, the sheep
suspect foul play and start to investigate under the noses of the incompetent
local police. The talking sheep are voiced by an array of British and American
screen talent and Emma Thompson delivers a great cameo as George’s solicitor.
Think Babe meets The Thursday Murder Club.
tmdb_overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Tuner 
Genre(s): Crime/Drama/Music/Romance/ThrillerCanada/USA | 2025 | 109 minsDirector: Daniel RoherCast: Leo Woodall, Dustin Hoffman, Havana Rose Liu.Our 7:30pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.Niki, a young piano tuner and apprentice to octogenarian
Harry, suffers from an extreme auditory sensitivity. This hyperacusis aids his
work but when Harry falls ill, it accidentally presents Niki with a way to pay
mounting medical bills as he cracks safes for Uri and his suspect security
firm. The central relationship between Niki and concert pianist and aspiring
composer Ruthie rings true in its complexity as the tension builds. Stylishly
shot with snappy editing and a cracking score, this debut feature cleverly
combines taut suspense and relationship drama in present day New York.
tmdb_overview: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes.

reunites the voice cast and creative team behind Zootropolis(2016)
with critics widely agreeing it was worth the wait. In a world populated only
by animals, bunny cop Judy Hopps and new recruit, Nick Wilde the fox, team up

references for the adults, slick animation, warmth and humour for the kids,

tmdb_overview: Born in 1931, Teishiro Minami launched Japan’s first commercial gay magazine, coordinated a queer helpline and organised the nation’s first Pride parade in 1994. Comprising a rich trove of archive footage and vibrant animation, Hiroaki Matsuoka’s documentary honours Minami’s legacy.

As she thrives in this new colorful world, she is suddenly confronted by debilitating menstrual cramps that become real-life monsters, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.

tmdb_overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

synopsis: A beloved musician transitions and risks everything - including his voice - to live authentically as Dylan Holloway.
tmdb_overview: A singer’s voice—and identity—evolve in this raw, lyrical journey through gender transition, loss, and self-discovery. British artist Dylan Holloway, formerly known as Lots Holloway, stepped away from the spotlight during the 2020 lockdown to begin his gender transition. Once a rising star on the UK’s X-Factor, Dylan now faces a profound personal and professional crossroads: hormone therapy could irreversibly change the voice that once defined his career. Blending candid video diaries, family footage, and intimate interviews, Tomorrow’s Too Late traces Dylan’s early life, his struggle with identity, and the emotional toll of life lived in public. At once a music documentary and a deeply moving portrait of trans experience, the film captures the courage it takes to risk everything in pursuit of an authentic self.

tmdb_overview: A singer’s voice—and identity—evolve in this raw, lyrical journey through gender transition, loss, and self-discovery. tmdb_overview: Widely considered Britain’s most popular artist, David Hockney is a global sensation with exhibitions in London, New York, Paris and beyond, attracting millions of visitors worldwide.  Now entering his 9th decade, Hockney shows absolutely no evidence of slowing down or losing his trademark boldness.  Featuring intimate and in-depth interviews with Hockney, this revealing film focuses on two blockbuster exhibitions held in 2012 and 2016 at the Royal Academy of Art in London.  Director Phil Grabsky secured privileged access to craft this cinematic celebration of a 21st century master of creativity.

Ruthless silver miner, turned oil prospector, Daniel Plainview, moves to oil-rich California. Using his son to project a trustworthy, family-man image, Plainview cons local landowners into selling him their valuable properties for a pittance. However, local preacher Eli Sunday suspects Plainview's motives and intentions, starting a slow-burning feud that threatens both their lives.

tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

synopsis:
Flint Lockwood invents a machine that showers food from the sky to help his townspeople, who can only afford to eat sardines. Soon, it runs out of control, burying the town in gigantic mounds of food.

Columbia Pictures' and Sony Pictures Animation's "Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs" will be the most delicious event since macaroni met cheese. Inspired by the beloved children's book, the film focuses on a town where food falls from the sky like rain.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis: Based on Virginia Woolf’s funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about the passionate astronomer, Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.
tmdb_overview: Based on Virginia Woolf’s funniest novel, Night & Day is an unromantic comedy about a passionate astronomer who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. The story of heroine Katharine Hilbery’s bold challenge to the Edwardian patriarchy is set against the backdrop of the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology, at the turn of the 20th century.

synopsis: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.
tmdb_overview: When renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner learns of the sudden death of a patient, she suspects murder. She mounts a private investigation, enlisting an odd assortment of quirky characters.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

synopsis: After the daughter of Wang Wei (Xie Miao) is kidnapped by a criminal network and he receives no help from the corrupt police, Wei sets out on a rampage to find her himself. His only ally is Navin (Joe Taslim) -- a relentless journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo ruthlessly fights against the kidnappers in this explosive martial arts showdown.

Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo ruthlessly battle the kidnappers in this explosive martial arts showdown.

synopsis: Niki (Leo Woodall) is a gifted young piano tuner whose heightened sense of hearing draws the attention of criminals, who see his talents as useful for opening safes as for tuning Steinways. With his once-promising musical career over, he now works across New York under the guidance of his mentor Harry Horowitz (Academy Award-winner Dustin Hoffman), encountering a range of characters, including composition student Ruthie (Havana Rose Liu), with whom he forges an unexpected connection. Niki’s safecracking work threatens his budding romance with Ruthie and pulls him into increasingly dangerous territory.
tmdb_overview: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with a reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 28 June, for a relaxed screening of Toy Story 5 - The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.

BBFC Content Warning - Toy Story 5 is rated PG with mild bad language, rude humour. Check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/toy-story-5-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmdm0mtkz
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

Columbia Pictures' and Sony Pictures Animation's "Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs" will be the most delicious event since macaroni met cheese. Inspired by the beloved children's book, the film focuses on a town where food falls from the sky like rain.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movie_title_en: Backrooms: Everything Must Go Edition w/ Bonus Footage
synopsis:
Backrooms returns to Everyman with an additional 15 minutes of footage.

A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).
tmdb_overview: If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

movie_title: Nolan in 35mm: The Dark Knight Rises
movie_title_en: Nolan in 35mm: The Dark Knight Rises
synopsis:
Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the politcian's reputation but is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. 

Eight years after the events of The Dark Knight, Batman returns to Gotham, where he encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, and must confront the latter's plans to destroy the city. But the city he strives to protect has branded him an enemy.

Screening in 35mm as part of Nolan Season at Everyman Screen on the Green.

synopsis:
After serving fifteen years in prison, bank robber Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is determined to recover the stolen money his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen) buried years earlier. There's just one problem: Manfred, caught in an identity crisis and convinced he is John Lennon, can no longer remember where it is hidden. The brothers set off on an increasingly chaotic hunt for the missing fortune, digging up old family secrets on the way.

Beyond screens every Monday matinee and Tuesday evening, showcasing independent films that might not be on your radar (yet!) but are well worth experiencing on the big screen.
The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.
tmdb_overview: When renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner learns of the sudden death of a patient, she suspects murder. She mounts a private investigation, enlisting an odd assortment of quirky characters.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.
tmdb_overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. 

We are coming close to... Disclosure Day.

Universal Pictures is proud to release a new original event film created and directed by Steven Spielberg, Disclosure Day. An upcoming sci-fi film directed by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by David Koepp.

The film stars SAG winner and Oscar® nominee Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Emmy and Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Oscar® winner Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple) and two-time Oscar® nominee Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin).

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
Based on Virginia Woolf’s funniest novel, Night & Day is an un-romantic comedy about the passionate astronomer, Katharine Hilbery who does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology. Fun and contemporary in tone, this refreshing film showcases a star-studded ensemble of humorous performances.

movie_title_en: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
synopsis:
The Mandalorian and Grogu embark on their most thrilling mission yet in Lucasfilm’s “Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu,” an all-new Star Wars adventure.

Following the fall of the evil Galactic Empire, Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his young apprentice Grogu. Attempting to rescue Rotta the Hutt in exchange for information from the Hutt clan on a New Republic target.

Directed by Jon Favreau, “Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu” also stars Sigourney Weaver, Martin Scorsese, Jeremy Allen White, Steve Blum and more.

Please note that STAR WARS: THE MANDALORIAN AND GROGU contains several sequences with flashing lights that may affect those who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy or have other photosensitivities.

synopsis:
500 MILES is a poetic, life-affirming road movie and celebration of the human spirit that follows a broken family who are forced to come together when two young brothers run away from home.

While their fighting parents (Clare Dunne & Michael Socha) tear their hair out with worry, runaways Finn (Roman Griffin Davis) and his live-wire younger brother Charlie (Dexter Sol Ansell) embark on an epic adventure from Yorkshire, over land and sea, to the Wild West coast of Ireland. With the free-spirited busker Cate (Maisie Williams) helping the young boys along the way, their destination is Dingle, County Kerry, and their estranged, beloved Grandfather (BAFTA-award winner Bill Nighy), who their parents haven’t spoken to since the fateful events of the previous summer.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
Frida Kahlo is a phenomenon. She is arguably the world’s favourite female artist – beloved by young and old. Exhibition on Screen’s award-winning film – first released during covid to a restricted audience - is back by popular demand with an exciting new addition from the blockbuster transatlantic exhibition from Tate Britain and MFA Houston 'Frida Kahlo: the Making of an Icon'. 
  
Who was Frida Kahlo? Everyone knows her face but who was the woman behind the bright colours, the big brows and the floral crowns? Take a journey through the life of a true icon, discover her art, and uncover the true story of her rebellious, passionate and turbulent life. 
  
Making use of the latest technology to deliver previously unimaginable quality, we take an in-depth look at key works throughout her career. Using letters Kahlo wrote to guide us, this definitive film reveals her deepest emotions and unlocks the secrets and symbolism contained within her art. 
  
Exhibition on Screen’s trademark combination of interviews with those who knew her and world experts, commentary and a detailed exploration of her art, combined with new special bonus footage from the 2026 Tate exhibition, delivers a treasure trove of colour and emotion. This personal and intimate film offers privileged access to her works, her home, her studio and highlights the source of her feverish creativity, her resilience and her unmatched lust for life, beauty and revolution. 
  
Created in close collaboration with world experts and those who knew her. 
  
Additional new material from the curators of the groundbreaking new Tate Britain and MFA Houston exhibition.

synopsis:
In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

Screening in 35mm as part of Nolan Season at Everyman Screen on the Green.
